blurb: San Diego Bay Cruises offers private yacht charters for events such as romantic dinner cruises, corporate events, weddings, sport fishing, sunset cruises, and wildlife watching. All yachts are operated by U.S. Coast Guard licensed captains and professional crew. They provide a variety of yacht types including motor yachts, mega yachts, sailing yachts, catamarans, and small boats.

quotes.text: Captain John and First mate Brandy provided us and our family and friends a wonderful harbor cruise for about 36 people. They really did take care of everything. They took all of our snacks and drinks on board before we boarded, and prepared them beautifully for the guests. We received a very good safety briefing, and then we boarded. The cruise itself was lovely, and Captain John was willing to answer questions about various landmarks and activities happening on the harbor. Thank you John and Brandy, it was a wonderful cruise! I would definitely do this again.
